text: The predicate excludes moz-abosxdirectory: and moz-aboutlookdirectory: before checking childCardCount; system contacts alone do not satisfy that populated-book condition. Correction to528058b0…: the added task uses AppConstants.platform != "macos" as skip_if. The inspected comm source proves that literal guard, not the earlier macOS-only interpretation; paired AppConstants runtime values were not checked. The task attempts native-book creation, treats any caught error as a preexisting book, and asserts isFirstRun without arranging or asserting a positive native contact count. It has no Outlook case. Keep those test limits and the other first-run conditions. No native profile or platform test ran.
title: First-run native-book exclusion has a literal platform guard in its test
